column1: # What a row of a family is with respect to withdrawal and standing, where the derivation from the other columns does not give it:
# four read-only columns of manifests/family_model.json (subject_may_withdraw, accountability_record, may_carry_under, standing_act).
# Applied by tools/build_family_model.py over the derived value. family: a family's name, or a stem ending in a colon that takes every
# family under it. selector: * for the whole family, or leaf=NAME where one value does not describe the family.
# source: quote (words stands verbatim in cc_ref, and the build fails when it no longer does) | ruling (a ruled reading the text does
# not yet state for this family by name; words is the note) | open (no value; words is the sentence the text would need).
# column _meta: a rule or a note that is no family's cell, keyed in the family field, its statement in value; every such row quotes.
# value: true | false for the three boolean columns; offer | end | acceptance | exercise | none for standing_act; - where open.

column4: a family whose names_head is roster, standing or by_placement is exercise, and one whose names_head is none is none: a row that names a head is signed in exercise of the standing that head seats; under by_placement a row that names no head exercises none

column4: a family whose confers cell is an ending is end; a family whose confers cell has the role acceptance is acceptance
column7: A row that ends a standing carries `refs.head` beside its target: a withdrawal of an acceptance or of an offer, an unseating, a resignation.

column4: the payload member lifts is admitted only on a counted end: a row whose standing_act is end and whose authorship arm is counted, or a counted withdraws whose target's standing_act is offer
column7: A count that ends a standing MAY state `lifts`, and then only the count's own receipts keep an act in force.

column4: an end signed by one voice (a resignation, a withdraws by the signer of its target, an end whose authorship arm is authored) is no counted end, and lifts on it is refused lifts_on_own_end
column7: One's own end lifts nothing, and `lifts` on it is refused, `lifts_on_own_end`.

column4: withdraws is a composer row type and no family, so it has no cell: a withdraws is an end where its target's standing_act is offer or acceptance, and a counted end where it is itself counted (CC 2.4.1.1 rule 0) and its target's standing_act is offer
column7: An offer conferred by a count is ended by its holder or by a count, never by its proposer alone.
